title: 网络安全 · 云安全架构与运营 30 句
description: 覆盖云上责任边界、身份权限、网络、配置、容器、密钥、日志与多云治理的高级英语表达。

items.zh: 云服务商保护底层基础设施，但客户仍需负责工作负载配置和数据访问。
items.en: The cloud provider protects the underlying infrastructure, while the client remains responsible for workload configuration and data access.
answers: The cloud provider protects the underlying infrastructure, while the client remains responsible for workload configuration and data access.
items.notes: while 对比共享责任双方；remain responsible for 是正式责任表达。

items.zh: 使用托管数据库减少了系统维护工作，却没有把数据分类责任转移给供应商。
items.en: Using a managed database reduces system maintenance, but it does not transfer responsibility for data classification to the provider.
answers: Using a managed database reduces system maintenance, but it does not transfer responsibility for data classification to the provider.
items.notes: 动名词作主语；transfer responsibility to 表示责任转移。

items.zh: 在采用新云服务前，团队应确认哪些安全控制由平台原生提供。
items.en: Before adopting a new cloud service, the team should establish which security controls are provided natively by the platform.
answers: Before adopting a new cloud service, the team should establish which security controls are provided natively by the platform.
items.notes: establish which 表示查明；natively 指平台原生提供。

items.zh: 合同承诺可用性并不意味着客户的应用架构自动具备跨区域韧性。
items.en: A contractual availability commitment does not mean that the client's application architecture is automatically resilient across regions.
answers: A contractual availability commitment does not mean that the client's application architecture is automatically resilient across regions.
items.notes: does not mean that 限制错误推论；resilient across 描述跨区域能力。

items.zh: 若服务需要客户管理加密密钥，密钥不可用也会导致数据无法访问。
items.en: Where a service relies on customer-managed encryption keys, loss of key availability can also make the data inaccessible.
answers: Where a service relies on customer-managed encryption keys, loss of key availability can also make the data inaccessible.
items.notes: where 引出特定服务模型；make A B 是宾补结构。

items.zh: 联合身份认证让用户使用企业账户登录，同时避免在每个平台维护独立密码。
items.en: Federated authentication allows users to sign in with corporate identities while avoiding separate passwords on each platform.
answers: Federated authentication allows users to sign in with corporate identities while avoiding separate passwords on each platform.
items.notes: allow someone to do；while avoiding 表示同时避免另一做法。

items.zh: 权限边界可以限制管理员授予的最大权限，但不能纠正每个不当的角色分配。
items.en: A permissions boundary can limit the maximum access an administrator may grant, but it cannot correct every inappropriate role assignment.
answers: A permissions boundary can limit the maximum access an administrator may grant, but it cannot correct every inappropriate role assignment.
items.notes: may grant 是省略关系代词的定语结构；but 区分机制能力边界。

items.zh: 临时高权限应在批准期限结束后自动撤销，而不是依赖人工清理。
items.en: Temporary privileged access should expire automatically at the end of the approved period rather than depend on manual removal.
answers: Temporary privileged access should expire automatically at the end of the approved period rather than depend on manual removal.
items.notes: expire automatically 表示自动到期；rather than 对比治理方式。

items.zh: 跨账户角色允许中央团队调查事件，而无需在每个账户创建长期用户。
items.en: A cross-account role enables the central team to investigate incidents without creating permanent users in every account.
answers: A cross-account role enables the central team to investigate incidents without creating permanent users in every account.
items.notes: enable someone to do；without doing 表示避免长期账户。

items.zh: 如果工作负载仍使用静态访问密钥，迁移到云端并不会消除凭据泄露风险。
items.en: If workloads continue to use static access keys, moving them to the cloud will not eliminate the risk of credential exposure.
answers: If workloads continue to use static access keys, moving them to the cloud will not eliminate the risk of credential exposure.
items.notes: if 引出持续做法；动名词短语 moving... 作主语。

items.zh: 私有子网减少了直接互联网暴露，但流量仍可能通过受信任服务离开环境。
items.en: A private subnet reduces direct internet exposure, although traffic may still leave the environment through an authorised service.
answers: A private subnet reduces direct internet exposure, although traffic may still leave the environment through an authorised service.
items.notes: although 引出剩余风险；through 表示流量路径。

items.zh: 安全组规则引用应用角色，比允许整个地址段更能适应动态扩缩容。
items.en: Security-group rules that reference application roles adapt to dynamic scaling better than rules that permit an entire address range.
answers: Security-group rules that reference application roles adapt to dynamic scaling better than rules that permit an entire address range.
items.notes: 两个 that 从句构成具体比较；adapt to 是固定搭配。

items.zh: 仅允许出站流量并不等于没有风险，因为被攻陷的工作负载仍可连接外部服务。
items.en: Allowing outbound traffic only does not remove risk, because a compromised workload can still connect to an external service.
answers: Allowing outbound traffic only does not remove risk, because a compromised workload can still connect to an external service.
items.notes: 动名词作主语；because 解释出站通道的风险。

items.zh: 东西向流量缺少检查时，同一虚拟网络内的攻击可能绕过边界设备。
items.en: Where east-west traffic is not inspected, an attack within the same virtual network may bypass the perimeter controls.
answers: Where east-west traffic is not inspected, an attack within the same virtual network may bypass the perimeter controls.
items.notes: where 引出控制缺口；bypass 表示绕过。

items.zh: 网络流日志能显示连接元数据，却不能证明加密会话中传输了什么内容。
items.en: Network flow logs reveal connection metadata but cannot establish what was transferred within an encrypted session.
answers: Network flow logs reveal connection metadata but cannot establish what was transferred within an encrypted session.
items.notes: reveal ... but cannot establish 限定日志能力；what 引导宾语从句。

items.zh: 基础设施即代码使配置可以复核和重复部署，前提是手工变更受到限制。
items.en: Infrastructure as code makes configurations reviewable and repeatable, provided that manual changes are restricted.
answers: Infrastructure as code makes configurations reviewable and repeatable, provided that manual changes are restricted.
items.notes: make A B 是宾补；provided that 引出实现收益的前提。

items.zh: 策略检查在部署前发现公开存储桶，避免了错误配置进入生产环境。
items.en: The policy check detected a public storage bucket before deployment, preventing the misconfiguration from reaching production.
answers: The policy check detected a public storage bucket before deployment, preventing the misconfiguration from reaching production.
items.notes: prevent A from doing 表示阻止；现在分词说明结果。

items.zh: 自动修复适合确定性较高的违规项，而有业务例外的配置仍需人工评估。
items.en: Automated remediation suits deterministic violations, whereas configurations with business exceptions still require human assessment.
answers: Automated remediation suits deterministic violations, whereas configurations with business exceptions still require human assessment.
items.notes: whereas 对比适用场景；deterministic 指可确定处理。

items.zh: 配置快照说明资源在某一时点的状态，却不能单独解释谁进行了变更。
items.en: A configuration snapshot shows the state of a resource at a point in time, but it cannot by itself explain who made the change.
answers: A configuration snapshot shows the state of a resource at a point in time, but it cannot by itself explain who made the change.
items.notes: at a point in time 表示时点；by itself 限定单一证据能力。

items.zh: 偏离基线的资源会生成告警，但基线本身也必须随着架构变化而复核。
items.en: Resources that drift from the baseline generate alerts, but the baseline itself must also be reviewed as the architecture evolves.
answers: Resources that drift from the baseline generate alerts, but the baseline itself must also be reviewed as the architecture evolves.
items.notes: drift from 表示配置漂移；as 表示随架构演进。

items.zh: 容器镜像通过漏洞扫描，不代表运行时配置或挂载的密钥同样安全。
items.en: A container image passing a vulnerability scan does not imply that its runtime configuration or mounted secrets are secure.
answers: A container image passing a vulnerability scan does not imply that its runtime configuration or mounted secrets are secure.
items.notes: does not imply that 限制供应链检查结论；passing 作后置修饰。

items.zh: 集群管理员权限应与云账户管理员权限分离，因为两者控制不同的信任层。
items.en: Cluster-administrator privileges should be separated from cloud-account administration because the two govern different layers of trust.
answers: Cluster-administrator privileges should be separated from cloud-account administration because the two govern different layers of trust.
items.notes: separate A from B；govern 表示控制某层信任。

items.zh: 若编排平台允许特权容器，攻击者可能从应用边界扩展到宿主机。
items.en: If the orchestration platform permits privileged containers, an attacker may be able to move beyond the application boundary to the host.
answers: If the orchestration platform permits privileged containers, an attacker may be able to move beyond the application boundary to the host.
items.notes: may be able to 保留可能性；move beyond 表示突破边界。

items.zh: 无服务器函数寿命很短，因此调查依赖集中日志，而不是事后检查单个实例。
items.en: Serverless functions are short-lived, so investigations depend on centralised logs rather than later inspection of individual instances.
answers: Serverless functions are short-lived, so investigations depend on centralised logs rather than later inspection of individual instances.
items.notes: depend on A rather than B；short-lived 说明取证方式原因。

items.zh: 镜像签名证明制品来自受信任流程，但只有验证签名才能在部署时实施这一信任。
items.en: Image signing proves that an artefact came from a trusted process, but signature verification is required to enforce that trust at deployment.
answers: Image signing proves that an artefact came from a trusted process, but signature verification is required to enforce that trust at deployment.
items.notes: prove that 与 be required to 区分签名和验证作用。

items.zh: 审计日志必须发送到工作负载账户无法修改的独立位置。
items.en: Audit logs must be sent to a separate location that workload accounts cannot modify.
answers: Audit logs must be sent to a separate location that workload accounts cannot modify.
items.notes: that 引导定语从句限定独立日志位置；cannot modify 强调防篡改。

items.zh: 密钥轮换降低长期暴露，却不能撤销已经使用旧密钥签发的会话。
items.en: Key rotation limits long-term exposure, but it does not revoke sessions that were already issued with the old key.
answers: Key rotation limits long-term exposure, but it does not revoke sessions that were already issued with the old key.
items.notes: but 区分轮换效果与遗留会话；that 引导定语从句。

items.zh: 跨云统一策略便于治理，不过必须映射到各平台实际支持的控制。
items.en: A common policy across clouds simplifies governance, although it must be mapped to controls that each platform actually supports.
answers: A common policy across clouds simplifies governance, although it must be mapped to controls that each platform actually supports.
items.notes: although 引出统一政策的实施限制；map to 表示映射。

items.zh: 成本异常有时是资源滥用的早期信号，但在升级安全事件前仍需业务背景。
items.en: A cost anomaly can be an early indicator of resource abuse, but business context is still required before it is escalated as a security incident.
answers: A cost anomaly can be an early indicator of resource abuse, but business context is still required before it is escalated as a security incident.
items.notes: can be 保持可能性；before 被动结构说明升级门槛。

items.zh: 云安全态势评分适合追踪趋势，却不应取代对关键攻击路径的验证。
items.en: A cloud-security posture score is useful for tracking trends, but it should not replace validation of critical attack paths.
answers: A cloud-security posture score is useful for tracking trends, but it should not replace validation of critical attack paths.
items.notes: be useful for doing；should not replace 限定评分用途。
